description: H205F22 W1 parameterless capture of pinned non-root Linux safety evidence. Root SSM transport verifies root-owned package manifest/files, then drops to metaengine-w1. No network fetch, nested documents, provider mutation, reboot, persistence or canonical authority.

runCommand:
set -eu
umask 077
PACKAGE_ROOT='/opt/metaengine/w1/safety/73ab09c75b71a6ea40f11e953cbcf9d9b94b9a89'
MANIFEST="$PACKAGE_ROOT/manifest.json"
WORKSPACE='/var/lib/metaengine/w1/workspace'
EXEC_USER='metaengine-w1'
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v runuser >/dev/null 2>&1
TMPDIR_W1="$(mktemp -d /tmp/metaengine-w1-safety.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR_W1"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,pwd,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256='71f509fb4f8dd18117f48c8444698ef7127ded4a32beb73de548d3cfa67ee01a'
EXPECTED_SCHEMA='metaengine.compute.w1-host-safety-package-manifest.h205f22.v1'
EXPECTED_COMMIT='73ab09c75b71a6ea40f11e953cbcf9d9b94b9a89'
EXPECTED_TREE='c8ae850c8ce2ab9f688ae0525cbce55d39186d78'
EXPECTED_ROOT='/opt/metaengine/w1/safety/73ab09c75b71a6ea40f11e953cbcf9d9b94b9a89'
EXPECTED_USER='metaengine-w1'
EXPECTED_WORKSPACE='/var/lib/metaengine/w1/workspace'
manifest_path=Path(sys.argv[1])
root=Path(EXPECTED_ROOT)
def safe_root_owned(path, require_dir=False):
    st=path.lstat()
    if require_dir and not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError('required_directory_missing')
    if not require_dir and not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError('required_regular_file_missing')
    if st.st_uid != 0 or st.st_gid != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('package_root_ownership_invalid')
    if st.st_mode & (stat.S_IWGRP|stat.S_IWOTH):
        raise RuntimeError('package_group_world_writable')
    return st
safe_root_owned(root, True)
safe_root_owned(manifest_path, False)
raw=manifest_path.read_bytes()
if not raw or len(raw)>65536:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_size_invalid')
if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_sha256_mismatch')
m=json.loads(raw)
if m.get('schema')!=EXPECTED_SCHEMA or m.get('source_commit_sha')!=EXPECTED_COMMIT or m.get('source_tree_sha')!=EXPECTED_TREE:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_source_identity_mismatch')
if m.get('package_root')!=EXPECTED_ROOT or m.get('execution_user')!=EXPECTED_USER or m.get('workspace_root')!=EXPECTED_WORKSPACE:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_runtime_identity_mismatch')
if m.get('authority') != {'canonical':False,'authority_effect':False,'provider_mutation':False,'database_mutation':False,'reboot_authorized':False,'worker_admitted':False,'w1_verified':False}:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_authority_not_neutral')
transport=m.get('transport')
if transport != {'network_fetch_allowed':False,'runtime_parameters_allowed':False,'nested_document_allowed':False}:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_transport_surface_invalid')
files=m.get('files')
if not isinstance(files,list) or len(files)!=3:
    raise RuntimeError('manifest_file_set_invalid')
expected={'worker/native_linux/host_safety_envelope_probe.py':'778c10804a7e8d8400a8c830f336dc53d1f8b790','controller/w1/host_safety_envelope_validator.py':'c35f1f5cf999badca23f04cd14938a8b885df382','controller/w1/host_safety_evidence_bundle.py':'bb66341c96c75eb7ece18432ead122f8da53df55'}
seen={}
for item in files:
    if not isinstance(item,dict) or set(item)!= {'path','git_blob_sha1'}:
        raise RuntimeError('manifest_file_entry_invalid')
    rel=item['path']
    if not isinstance(rel,str):
        raise RuntimeError('manifest_file_path_invalid')
    p=PurePosixPath(rel)
    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or rel not in expected:
        raise RuntimeError('manifest_file_path_forbidden')
    if item['git_blob_sha1']!=expected[rel]:
        raise RuntimeError('manifest_git_blob_mismatch')
    target=root.joinpath(*p.parts)
    safe_root_owned(target, False)
    data=target.read_bytes()
    git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode('ascii')+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()
    if git_blob!=expected[rel]:
        raise RuntimeError('package_file_git_blob_mismatch')
    seen[rel]=git_blob
if seen != expected:
    raise RuntimeError('package_file_set_mismatch')
acct=pwd.getpwnam(EXPECTED_USER)
if acct.pw_uid==0:
    raise RuntimeError('execution_user_must_be_nonroot')
workspace=Path(EXPECTED_WORKSPACE)
wst=workspace.lstat()
if not stat.S_ISDIR(wst.st_mode) or stat.S_ISLNK(wst.st_mode):
    raise RuntimeError('workspace_invalid')
if wst.st_uid != acct.pw_uid:
    raise RuntimeError('workspace_owner_invalid')
if wst.st_mode & (stat.S_IWGRP|stat.S_IWOTH):
    raise RuntimeError('workspace_group_world_writable')
PY
OUT="$TMPDIR_W1/bundle.json"
set +e
printf '%s' '{"source":{"git_sha":"73ab09c75b71a6ea40f11e953cbcf9d9b94b9a89","tree_sha":"c8ae850c8ce2ab9f688ae0525cbce55d39186d78"}}' | runuser -u "$EXEC_USER" -- python3 "$PACKAGE_ROOT/controller/w1/host_safety_evidence_bundle.py" > "$OUT"
RC=$?
set -e
if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ] && [ "$RC" -ne 2 ]; then
  exit 41
fi
python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
EXPECTED_SCHEMA='metaengine.compute.w1-host-safety-evidence-bundle.h205f22.v2'
EXPECTED_COMMIT='73ab09c75b71a6ea40f11e953cbcf9d9b94b9a89'
EXPECTED_TREE='c8ae850c8ce2ab9f688ae0525cbce55d39186d78'
EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256='71f509fb4f8dd18117f48c8444698ef7127ded4a32beb73de548d3cfa67ee01a'
EXPECTED_USER='metaengine-w1'
EXPECTED_WORKSPACE='/var/lib/metaengine/w1/workspace'
raw=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
if not raw or len(raw)>262144:
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_size_invalid')
value=json.loads(raw)
if value.get('schema')!=EXPECTED_SCHEMA:
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_schema_invalid')
obs=value.get('observation')
if not isinstance(obs,dict) or obs.get('source')!={'git_sha':EXPECTED_COMMIT,'tree_sha':EXPECTED_TREE}:
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_source_mismatch')
ctx=value.get('execution_context')
if not isinstance(ctx,dict) or ctx.get('execution_user')!=EXPECTED_USER or ctx.get('workspace_root')!=EXPECTED_WORKSPACE or ctx.get('effective_uid') in (None,0):
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_execution_context_invalid')
if ctx.get('workspace_owned_by_execution_user') is not True or ctx.get('workspace_group_world_writable') is not False:
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_workspace_contract_invalid')
authority=value.get('authority')
expected_authority={'canonical':False,'authority_effect':False,'database_mutation':False,'provider_mutation':False,'reboot_authorized':False,'worker_admitted':False,'w1_verified':False}
if authority!=expected_authority:
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_authority_not_neutral')
neutral={k:v for k,v in value.items() if k not in ('schema','bundle_sha256')}
canonical=json.dumps(neutral,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
if hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()!=value.get('bundle_sha256'):
    raise RuntimeError('bundle_self_hash_invalid')
courier={'schema':'metaengine.compute.w1-aws-ssm-safety-courier.h205f22.v1','source':'HOST_UNTRUSTED_TRANSPORT','transport':'AWS_SSM_RUN_COMMAND_FIXED_DOCUMENT','package_source_commit_sha':EXPECTED_COMMIT,'package_source_tree_sha':EXPECTED_TREE,'package_manifest_sha256':EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256,'bundle_base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'),'bundle_transport_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bundle_safety_eligible':bool(value.get('safety_eligible')),'host_safety_verified':False,'provider_identity_verified':False,'reboot_completion_proven':False,'persistent_worker_proof':False,'w1_verified':False,'canonical':False,'authority_effect':False}
encoded=json.dumps(courier,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
if len(encoded)>18000:
    raise RuntimeError('courier_stdout_too_large')
print(encoded)
PY
